cohort: The study included 105,528 live singleton births born to nulliparous and multiparous mothers aged 20 years and older in Qingdao.
finding: Maternal GDM increased the risk of preterm birth in both nulliparous and multiparous mothers, but recurrent GDM was not associated with a further increase in the risk of prematurity in multiparous mothers, and GDM did not contribute to very preterm birth irrespective of parity.
